Definition: Zoba or Zobah, a region of Syria
BiblicalUsage: Zobah is a kingdom in Syria, whose kings fought against Saul and David. In 1 Samuel 14:47, against the kings of Zobah. The place has its own entry in Biblical Places.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zobah matters because the gospel travelled through real places, and God met His people where they lived.
